reason: Batch 003 source audit corrected the wrong Group D storage premise. PD 1096 classifies Group D as Institutional and Group G as Storage and Hazardous; RA 9514 supplies protected-exit and special-hazard rules.

proposed.text: A high-hazard Group G paint storage room is directly below a Group B office suite. If the designer uses a fire-resistance separation rather than relying only on automatic protection, what minimum fire-resistance rating is source-backed for the hazardous storage condition?
proposed.rationale: RA 9514 Section 10.2.6.10(A) supports at least four-hour fire resistance for storage hazards greater than normal occupancy; high-hazard cases may require both construction and automatic protection.
proposed.explanation: This replaces the wrong Group D storage premise.
proposed.code_citation: PD 1096 Rule VII Group G; RA 9514 2019 RIRR Section 10.2.6.10(A)
